+def parse_quantity(token):

+    text = token.replace(",", "").replace("_", "")

+    if not text.isdigit() or not token[0].isdigit():

+        return None

+    return int(text)

+

+def load_stock_file(sde, path, label):

+    """Parse '{Item Name} {Quantity} ...' lines into {typeID: quantity}."""

+    if not os.path.isfile(path):

+        raise PlanError(f"{label} file not found: {path}")

+    lowered = {}

+    for name, ids in sde.by_name.items():

+        lowered.setdefault(name.lower(), ids)

+

+    def lookup(name):

+        ids = sde.by_name.get(name) or lowered.get(name.lower())

+        return min(ids) if ids else None

+

+    result = {}

+    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:

+        for lineno, raw in enumerate(fh, 1):

+            tokens = raw.split()

+            if not tokens or tokens[0].startswith("#"):

+                continue

+            found = None

+            unknown = None

+            for i in range(1, len(tokens)):

+                qty = parse_quantity(tokens[i])

+                if qty is None:

+                    continue

+                name = " ".join(tokens[:i])

+                tid = lookup(name)

+                if tid is not None:

+                    found = (tid, qty)

+                    break

+                if unknown is None:

+                    unknown = name

+            if found is None:

+                if unknown is not None:

+                    raise PlanError(f"{label} line {lineno}: No published item named '{unknown}' found in SDE")

+                raise PlanError(f"{label} line {lineno}: expected '{{Item Name}} {{Quantity}}', "

+                                f"got '{raw.strip()}'")

+            tid, qty = found

+            result[tid] = result.get(tid, 0) + qty

+    return result

+
